name: leetcode
description: Read your LeetCode progress and submissions, practice problems, run code, and submit solutions from your own account.

interface.shortDescription: Practice LeetCode with your account and progress.
interface.longDescription: A community desktop plugin for personal LeetCode practice. Sign in through LeetCode's own browser window, read your solved problems and submission history, run code, and submit solutions. Runs locally; each user connects their own account.
defaultPrompt: Run my solution and explain the result.
